component.name: Support queue status panel
component.purpose: Search support requests, select one, and stage a priority update in a self-contained browser preview.

authored_copy.heading: Support queue
authored_copy.help: Search requests, select one, and stage a priority change before saving.
authored_copy.search_help: Search by ticket ID or subject. Results update as you type.
authored_copy.priority_help: This is a staged change. Save to commit it, or cancel to restore the current value.
authored_copy.preview_controls_help: These local controls make service states reachable without an assistant or network connection.

accessibility_copy.panel_help: Search requests, select one, and stage a priority change before saving.
accessibility_copy.priority_help: This is a staged change. Save to commit it, or cancel to restore the current value.
accessibility_copy.keyboard_help: Use Tab to reach controls, Enter or Space to activate buttons, and the visible focus ring to track your place.

state_copy.invalid_message: Choose a valid priority before saving.
state_copy.invalid_fixture_message: Draft priority is invalid. Choose High, Medium, or Low.
state_copy.error_message: Unable to update the queue. Try again.
state_copy.cancelled_message: Edit cancelled; no changes were saved.
state_copy.empty_help: Try a different ID or subject, or clear the search to see the full queue.
state_copy.selection_message: Selected {id}. Priority is ready to edit.
state_copy.no_selection_message: Select a request to edit its priority.
state_copy.fallback_template: Text fallback: Support queue contains {count} visible requests. Select a request to view or stage its priority; saving is local to this preview.
state_copy.empty_fallback: Text fallback: No requests match the current search. Clear the search to restore the queue.

source_contract_identifiers.identifier_display_rule: Keep IDs, enum codes, tool names, and protocol/error codes exact and separate from English display wording.

equivalent_native_control_copy.surface_note: Host-rendered native controls must use the host's supported labels, theme, focus behavior, and confirmation flow.
equivalent_native_control_copy.search_help: Type an ID or subject to filter requests.
equivalent_native_control_copy.error_message: Unable to update the queue. Try again.
equivalent_native_control_copy.fallback_rule: If a host cannot render the panel, preserve the selected ID, current priority, and recovery action as text.

terminal_text_fallback_copy.title: Support queue
terminal_text_fallback_copy.instructions: Search by ID or subject. Select a request, choose a priority, then save or cancel.
terminal_text_fallback_copy.sample_line: T-104 | Cannot access my account | Priority: High | Status: Pending
terminal_text_fallback_copy.invalid_line: Invalid priority. Choose high, medium, or low.
terminal_text_fallback_copy.error_line: Unable to update the queue. Try again.
terminal_text_fallback_copy.cancelled_line: Edit cancelled; no changes were saved.
terminal_text_fallback_copy.fallback_rule: Always print a stable request ID, English labels, current values, and a retry or cancel path; do not print a raw protocol error alone.

styling.selection_source: Bundled skills/desktop-plugin-ui/assets/palettes/colorset1.yml; colorset1 is the default required by the loaded skill.
styling.styling_owner: The authored HTML fixture owns its iframe/browser paint. Any host frame, chrome, permission UI, or native control paint remains host-owned.

contrast_checks.ratio_note: High-contrast primary text pair; suitable for ordinary text.
Primary button pair selected from colorset1.
Selected and error surfaces use dark text; the red error accent is not used as the sole text color.

styling.redundant_status_cues: Status messages use text and a labeled live region; priority and pending status use text labels, not color alone.
styling.permitted_overrides: Forced-colors, high-contrast settings, and host accessibility overrides take precedence over exact fixture colors.

heuristic_review.label: Visible status
heuristic_review.interaction: refresh, save, cancel, empty and error feedback
heuristic_review.finding: Live status copy and a busy state are authored; runtime announcement timing remains unverified.
heuristic_review.fix_or_check: Exercise each state with a screen reader and verify the latest message is announced.

heuristic_review.label: Familiar concepts
heuristic_review.finding: Request IDs, subjects, priorities and statuses use familiar task vocabulary.
heuristic_review.fix_or_check: Confirm terminology with representative support users.

heuristic_review.label: Control and exits
heuristic_review.finding: Cancel edit, retry through Refresh queue, and clear search are available.
heuristic_review.fix_or_check: Verify focus and draft preservation after cancellation and failure.

heuristic_review.label: Consistent conventions
heuristic_review.finding: Native controls, explicit action labels and a visible focus ring are used.
heuristic_review.fix_or_check: Test Tab, Enter, Space and select behavior in the target host.

heuristic_review.label: Prevent mistakes
heuristic_review.finding: Priority is staged and locally validated before save.
heuristic_review.fix_or_check: Verify server-side validation and stale-version handling when connected.

heuristic_review.label: Recognition cues
heuristic_review.finding: Labels, current selection, priority and status appear beside controls.
heuristic_review.fix_or_check: Inspect accessible names and selected-row announcement in a runtime.

heuristic_review.label: Efficient paths
heuristic_review.finding: As-you-type search, keyboard focus, and one-step fixture actions shorten common paths.
heuristic_review.fix_or_check: Measure the narrow layout and keyboard-only path with realistic data.

heuristic_review.label: Minimal content
heuristic_review.finding: Core queue actions are primary; synthetic state controls are disclosed in a details region.
heuristic_review.fix_or_check: Confirm the preview controls are removed or hidden in a production integration.

heuristic_review.label: Useful errors
heuristic_review.finding: Errors explain recovery, preserve the current queue, and avoid exposing only a raw code.
heuristic_review.fix_or_check: Verify rejected authoritative responses preserve a compatible draft.

heuristic_review.label: Contextual help
heuristic_review.finding: Inline help and an export tooltip explain task behavior and scope.
heuristic_review.fix_or_check: Verify tooltip keyboard access and help placement at 320 CSS px.

local_checks.check: English authored copy and document language
local_checks.result: The HTML declares lang=en and visible/component copy is English; protocol identifiers remain exact.
Source includes local controls and handlers for search, selection, staged edit, save, cancel, busy, invalid, error, success, empty, export and reset.
local_checks.scope: local source inspection; browser fixture, not installed-host acceptance

local_checks.result: Authored CSS uses colorset1 tokens for surfaces, actions, focus, selection, error and neutral feedback.
Run the bundled checker on both completed outputs and inspect its JSON passed result before delivery.

remaining_host_limitations: This is a self-contained browser fixture; it does not register an MCP App, invoke queue_update_priority, or prove a visible assistant-host panel.
No installed assistant host, account, provider, service, transport, permission flow, or native control renderer was exercised.
Browser fixture behavior does not establish Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or any other host acceptance.
A real integration must perform authoritative server validation, preserve drafts on rejection, handle stale versions and out-of-order refresh responses, and enforce export authorization.
Host-owned chrome, theme mapping, dialogs, terminal colors, focus behavior and accessibility overrides may differ from this authored CSS.
